title: Count down from 5 to 1
description: Use a while loop to print 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. Then print Go!
solution:
number = 5
while number > 0:
    print(number)
    number -= 1
print("Go!")
hints: Read the task once and identify the Python feature it asks you to practise.

validation.feedback: Use while to decrease a number until the loop ends.

title: Add numbers 1 to 5 with while
description: Use a while loop to add the numbers from 1 to 5. Print the total.
solution:
total = 0
number = 1
while number <= 5:
    total += number
    number += 1
print(total)
hints: Read the task once and identify the Python feature it asks you to practise.
Build a total inside a while loop.
Write your own code, press Run, and fix any syntax or runtime error shown.
explanation: The loop adds 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 to total. The final sum is 15.
commonMistakes: Use number <= 5 so the loop includes 5. Increase number inside the loop to avoid an endless loop.

validation.feedback: Build a total inside a while loop.

title: Count the digits in 12345
description: Use a while loop to count the digits in 12345. Print how many digits it has.
solution:
number = 12345
count = 0
while number > 0:
    count += 1
    number //= 10
print(count)
hints: Read the task once and identify the Python feature it asks you to practise.
Use while and // 10 to process digits.
Write your own code, press Run, and fix any syntax or runtime error shown.
explanation: The loop removes the last digit with // 10 and adds 1 to count each time. 12345 has five digits.
commonMistakes: Start with 12345, increase count inside the loop, and remove one digit using //= 10.

validation.feedback: Use while and // 10 to process digits.
